claims_checked.claim: Conway 1968 quote; inverse Conway manoeuvre coined by Jonny LeRoy and Matt Simons (Cutter IT Journal, December 2010)
Team Topologies: 'overloaded teams make poor decisions and move slowly'; collaboration 'for a defined period of time to discover new things'; X-as-a-Service; facilitation; stream-aligned definition
Team Topologies published 2019 by Skelton and Pais
LeSS feature team 'long-lived, cross-functional, cross-component'; hybrid models have 'the drawbacks from both worlds'
LeSS lists component-team drawbacks as 'more planning, sequential development, many handoffs and high work in progress'
SAFe (updated 17 April 2023): four team types as template; most teams stream-aligned; no more than 1–3 complicated-subsystem teams per ART; two or three enabling teams across the enterprise common
Mountain Goat Software: '20% on five teams' is rarely experienced as 20% available; conditions for component teams
Disciplined Agile: component, feature, functional and internal open-source strategies; functional teams add communication overhead and project risk

Scrum Guide 2020: 'no sub-teams or hierarchies'; skills 'often broad and will vary with the domain of work'; multiple cohesive Scrum Teams share Product Goal, Product Backlog and Product Owner; no project manager accountability
ART usually 5 to 12 teams, 50 to 125 people
LeSS 2–8 teams; LeSS Huge requirement areas of 4–8 teams; Scrum@Scale Scrums of Scrums of four or five teams; Spotify tribes under about 100 people (2012)
